method.fps: Unique increasing capture identities; (frames-1)/(last-arrival-first-arrival), plus frames/60seconds
method.latency: Capture CLOCK_BOOTTIME to full received and SDK-envelope-validated packet; excludes H264 decoding/browser rendering/display.
method.cpu: Cgroup CPU seconds/wall seconds;100% equals one core. Observer reported separately.
method.matcher_timing: Deduplicate nested matcher_statistics.capture_sequence within stable run/epoch; repeated mono-only top-level timing excluded.
method.matcher_work: Sum unique observed completed matcher processing_ms; boundary and polling effects apply; compare sample count with matched_frames delta.

matcher_work.method: Sum of unique completed nested matcher_statistics.processing_ms / observed wall interval; boundary and polling sampling apply; not all-core utilization.

limitations: Host-local API throughput is not Wi-Fi-delivered or browser-rendered throughput.

Depth quality/calibration accuracy and all-core saturation are not established by this benchmark.
No stereo/calibration/exposure/auth controls were intentionally written; external changes abort the matrix and are preserved.
